title: oec-infra report, version 1
description: JSON report of the D8 infrastructure compliance CLI oec-infra (DESIGN.md §9, ADR-0025 amendment C-070). Its own document and version, independent of the oec-check report. Version 1 grows additively with the increments of P5b (new optional keys, new modes) and is frozen at the P5b exit; after that a change of a key or of its meaning increments report. Closed objects: a report carries no secret, no password and no file content of the image.

version.description: Version of oec-infra (dev for an unreleased build).

schemas.description: Release of the embedded D1 schema bundle.

baseline.description: Guideline commit of the embedded spec baseline.

catalog.description: Guideline baseline of the embedded test catalog d8.yaml.

command.description: Command line; passwords and passphrases are only read from files, so it holds none.

mode.description: Catalog mode of the judged tests.

input.description: image: the OCI layout directory or oci-archive as given on the command line; bus: the broker URL (mqtts://host:port); host: the root directory of the storages (C-072); container: the judged containers as given on the command line, comma separated (C-073); run: the image reference as given on the command line (C-074).

form.description: image: the form of the input.

summary.description: Number of implemented tests per outcome.

exit.description: Exit code of the run: 0 pass, 1 fail, 4 inconclusive (DESIGN.md §5.3).

image.description: image: what D8 found in the layout.

digest.description: Digest of the one descriptor of index.json; absent if it lists several.

index.description: The image is an image index (several manifests or a referenced index).

problems.description: Structure and integrity problems found while reading.

broker.description: bus: what D8 found on the Message Bus (C-071).

url.description: The broker URL of the run.

probe.description: Identification Link of the probe AppId of the run (topics Oi4v2/Utility/<probe>/…).

registry.description: Identification Link of the OEC Registry judged.

host.description: host: what D8 found in the storages and on the platform host (C-072). File names, modes and sizes only, never a file content.

root.description: The root directory of the run (--root, default /).

container.description: The container name of the certificate checks (--container, else etc/hostname below the root).

engine.description: T8-HST-03: the Engine API D8 read the containers from (C-073).

containers.description: T8-HST-03: the containers with a storage of RIG 4.1 (an OI4 container), except the one D8 runs in.

containerRun.description: container: the Engine API and the judged containers (C-073). No environment, no label, no address and no mount source.

runRun.description: run: the sandbox run of the application image (C-074) – the Engine API, the image, the MQTT test endpoint of D8 and one entry per phase. No secret, no username, no log, no environment and no host path.

ref.description: The image reference as given on the command line.

listen.description: The address the MQTT test endpoint listens on (each phase on its own port).

broker_host.description: Address of broker.json: the host name the container resolves to the endpoint, or an IP address.

cleanup.description: Problems while removing the containers or storages of the run.

runPhase.description: One container of the run: credentials (only username/password, broker certificate signed by the CA of ca.pem), certificate (only client certificate with encrypted key, broker certificate signed by the CA of broker_ca.pem) or untrusted (storages as in credentials, the endpoint presents a certificate of a CA the container does not know).

running.description: The container still ran at the end of the observation.

error.description: Why the phase could not run (create or start failed).

birth.description: The first MAM of the application about itself (Pub/MAM, Source = AppId).

runConnection.description: One TLS connection of the container to the MQTT test endpoint. The username and the password are never reported.

auth.description: How the CONNECT authenticated: the right username and password, other ones, the verified client certificate, nothing.

largest_payload.description: Octets of the largest PUBLISH payload.

engine.description: A Docker or Podman Engine API (C-073).

endpoint.description: unix://, tcp:// or npipe:// endpoint (or the endpoints tried, if none answered).

product.description: Product of GET /version (platform or Podman component name).

container.description: One container as inspected through the Engine API (C-073).

name.description: Container name without the leading slash.

image.description: Image reference of the container configuration.

network_mode.description: HostConfig.NetworkMode (bridge, host, none, container:<id>, a network name, pasta, slirp4netns …).

network.description: A network a container is attached to.

driver.description: Driver of the network (bridge, host, null, overlay, macvlan, ipvlan …); absent if D8 could not read it.

mount.description: A mount of a container: destination, type and mode; never the source on the host.

type.description: bind, volume, tmpfs, image, npipe, cluster.

storage.description: host: one container storage of RIG 4.1.

name.description: Message Bus storage (/etc/oi4/mqtt), OI4 certificate storage (/etc/oi4/certs) or secret storage (/run/secrets/oi4).

mount.description: ro/rw: the storage (or a file in it) is a mount point, or a read-only mount covers it; none: no mount of its own (not judged); unknown: no mount table on this system.

file.description: host: one entry of a storage.

platform.description: host: the measured properties of the platform host (RIG 5.1).

machine.description: Machine (processor architecture) of the kernel, e.g. x86_64, aarch64, armv7l.

memory.description: Main memory visible to the operating system in octets.

storage_source.description: What the storage value measures (block devices or a file system).

daemon.description: Endpoint of the container daemon found.

broker.description: The broker of broker.json D8 connected to.

registry.description: Identification Link of the OEC Registry found.

certificate.description: bus: the certificate the broker presented (no key, no PEM).

names.description: DNS names and IP addresses of the subject alternative name.

manifest.description: One image manifest of the layout.

platform.description: os/architecture[/variant] of the image config, else of the descriptor.

runnable.description: An image of a real platform (not an attestation manifest).

supported.description: A platform of RIG 5.1: linux/amd64, linux/arm64/v8, linux/arm/v7.

test.description: The verdict of one catalog test.

req.description: The verdict of one requirement within a test.

obligation.description: Keyword of the requirement at the declared level, none if it does not apply.

inconclusive.description: The requirement could not be judged in this run (a gap of the run, exit code 4 for MUST).

evidence.description: A pointer into the inspected image, the probed Message Bus, the host or a container.

image.description: The image manifest or platform the evidence belongs to.

topic.description: bus: the MQTT topic of a probe message.

container.description: container, T8-HST-03: the name of the container the evidence belongs to (C-073).

path.description: Path in the layout (e.g. blobs/sha256/…) or in the image file system (e.g. /opt/oi4/licenses/sbom.spdx.json); host: a file or directory of a storage; container: a path in the container.
